THE TESTNET
WORKSHOP.

Build the collection before the launch. Deploy a free test-token faucet and a fixed-price unlock shop, then try a verified burn with your wallet.

03 / DEPLOY

Open your test shop.

Your wallet confirms two deployments: the tGETAWAY faucet token, then its unlock shop. Progress saves here if you leave.

04 / LINK & MINT

Make your first burn.

Sign a wallet-link message, then claim 25,000 free tGETAWAY once per day. Create your game profile and join a neighborhood before claiming furniture or outfits.

Joining a friend’s test shop?

Each account chooses its test contracts. Import the same shop address to test together. Its deployed code is checked before it is enabled.

THE COLLECTION / EXACT COSTS

BURN. UNLOCK. MAKE IT YOURS.

Every item shows its cost before confirmation. The wallet approves that exact amount. Ownership is granted only after the burn and transaction are verified.

Finish a confirmed unlock
